title: Stylistic Evolution and LLM Neutrality in Singlish Language

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the standard deviation of stylistic similarity scores between LLM-generated Singlish texts and a real-world corpus of messages spanning 2012 to 2021 to evaluate if models exhibit diachronic bias toward specific time periods.

Training a machine learning classifier using handcrafted linguistic features (lexico-structural, pragmatic, psycholinguistic) and encoder-derived representations to evaluate the realism, stylistic authenticity, and sociolectal alignment of LLM-generated Singlish compared to a native corpus.
